cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says e-procurement runs from tender to award or payment, or is required of all public bodies, or gives a figure for it.
cells.note: The precautionary suspension of the Treasury's procurement portal in late October 2026 forced tender procedures to be rescheduled and bid deadlines put back (MAR-004), so bids go through a portal in service. The e-bidding arrêté of 2023 (MAR-003) is outside the window, so not 4.
